jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

About the Team:

We help people discover content and communities that make them want to return and participate. Our work connects personalized relevance with the health of the broader ecosystem: helping new users find their interests, elevating quality, and connecting communities with audiences who will value them. We care about both the usefulness of an individual recommendation and how discovery shapes the experience of users, contributors, and communities over time.

About the Role:

We’re looking for a Product Manager to lead Ecosystem Relevance, with a focus on new user experiences, content and community quality, and community coherence.

You’ll shape how our relevance systems serve people when we know little about them, recognize worthwhile content and communities, and account for the context that makes a recommendation appropriate. Working with ML engineering, data science, research, and consumer product teams, you’ll translate these goals into signals, ranking objectives, product experiences, and experiments that improve retention and participation while supporting a healthy ecosystem.

What You'll Do:

• Improve relevance for new users. Own the strategy for cold start recommendations, interest exploration, and early personalization so people find value in their first sessions.

• Make quality actionable. Develop definitions, signals, and evaluation methods for content and community quality, accounting for usefulness, originality, authenticity, and user feedback.

• Strengthen community coherence. Improve alignment between what a community is about, the content surfaced from it, and the interests, intent, and expectations of the people discovering it.

• Shape discovery across the ecosystem. Identify opportunities for new, emerging, and niche content and communities to reach suitable audiences, and address exposure patterns that limit discovery.

• Translate ecosystem goals into relevance decisions. Partner with engineering on candidate selection, ranking, exploration, diversity, and repetition controls across relevant consumer experiences.

• Build a balanced measurement framework. Assess early retention, satisfaction, successful discovery, negative feedback, and downstream participation and community health.

• Lead experiments and execution . Combine behavioral analysis, research, and controlled experiments to identify opportunities, prioritize a roadmap, and deliver measurable improvements with partner teams.

What We're Looking For:

• Experience shipping consumer products in recommendations, discovery, search, personalization, growth, or community ecosystems.

• Strong product intuition for new users and an understanding of how early experiences influence retention and longer-term participation.

• Analytical depth: the ability to define metrics, interpret experiments, investigate heterogeneous effects, and distinguish short-term engagement gains from durable improvements.

• Fluency in recommendation systems and experience partnering with ML engineers and data scientists on signals, objectives, and evaluation.

• An understanding of ecosystem dynamics, including feedback loops, exposure allocation, content supply, and the relationship between audience growth and community health.

• The ability to turn concepts such as quality and community coherence into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.

• Strong execution and cross-functional influence, with the judgment to navigate tradeoffs among personalization, exploration, quality, and ecosystem health.

Benefits:

• Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs

• 401k with Employer Match

• Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

• Family Planning Support

• Gender-Affirming Care

• Mental Health & Coaching Benefits

• Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off

• Generous Paid Parental Leave

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ .

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Sr. Cloud Platform Engineer to join our team. This is a Remote within the United States (with a hybrid preference for San Jose, CA) role, reporting to the Manager, IT Cloud Operations in the Cloud Platform Engineering department. Our team builds and operates the internal cloud platform that powers Zscaler's product and corporate infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and Azure. In this role, you will design and ship automation that provisions cloud environments, enforces security baselines, and integrates AI-assisted tooling and agentic workflows to accelerate delivery.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Build and extend Day 1 automation, including infrastructure provisioning pipelines, account vending, golden repo templates, and CI/CD components

• Build and extend Day 2 automation for lifecycle management, upgrade pipelines, dependency scanning, drift detection, and automated remediation workflows

• Write and maintain Terraform modules, GitLab CI/CD components, and Python automation to establish the platform's paved road

• Integrate AI and agentic tooling into operational workflows to reduce manual toil and increase operational consistency

• Collaborate with Security, IAM, Network, and FinOps teams to translate cross-functional requirements into automated guardrails

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity. You are comfortable building the path as you walk it, viewing dynamic environments as raw material to build something meaningful.

• You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action, seamlessly navigating between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

• You are a problem-solver. You seek out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving hard problems delivers maximum impact.

• You are a high-trust collaborator. You embrace a challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback with clarity, respect, and candor.

• You are a learner. You bring a true growth mindset and actively seek feedback to continuously develop yourself and support your team.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

• 5+ years of experience building and operating multi-cloud infrastructure at scale across major cloud platforms

• Hands-on expertise with Terraform, including module design, state management, and CI-driven workflows

• Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or equivalent languages

• Working knowledge of CI/CD pipeline design and Kubernetes operations

• Understanding of identity federation, secrets management, and least-privilege security patterns

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Experience with multi-account governance tooling such as AWS Control Tower, Organizations, SCPs, or RCPs

• Experience with GitOps patterns and automated infrastructure lifecycle tooling such as Renovate, Dependabot, or ArgoCD

• Experience with MLOps frameworks: kubeflow, ML flow, and model services like Bedrock, Sagemaker, Vertex AI, Gemini Enterprise

About the Team
Security is at the foundation of OpenAI’s mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Security team protects OpenAI’s technology, people, and products. We are technical in what we build but are operational in how we do our work, and are committed to supporting all products and research at OpenAI. Our Security team tenets include: prioritizing for impact, enabling researchers, preparing for future transformative technologies, and engaging a robust security culture.

About the Role
As a Security Engineer, Application Security you will be responsible for identifying and mitigating security vulnerabilities within software applications through building security tools, code reviews, penetration testing, and security assessments.

We’re looking for people who will work closely with development teams to ensure secure coding practices are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle, preventing security risks before they emerge. You will also provide security guidance to developers and other stakeholders, fostering a culture of security awareness within the organization.

The role is preferred to be based in San Francisco, Seattle or New York City but may consider remote work. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:
• Perform Security Assessments : Conduct regular security assessments, code reviews, and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in applications and software.

• Develop and Implement Security Tools : Design, develop, and implement security tools, frameworks, and methodologies to protect applications against security threats.

• Collaborate with Development Teams : Work closely with development teams to ensure security best practices are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including secure coding guidelines.

• Threat Modeling and Risk Assessment : Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments to proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies.

• Vulnerability Management : Track, analyze, and manage vulnerabilities in applications, providing guidance and support for remediation efforts.

• Incident Response Support : Assist in investigating, analyzing, and responding to security incidents related to applications, ensuring timely resolution and documentation of incidents.

• Stay Current on Security Trends : Continuously stay updated on the latest security threats, vulnerabilities, and technologies to enhance security measures in applications.

You might thrive in this role if you:
• Extensive experience in information security, cybersecurity, or a related field, with a significant portion of that experience in leadership or management roles.

• Deep understanding of security technologies, tools, and best practices, including experience with secure coding practices, threat modeling, risk assessments, and incident response.

• Experience in application security, software development, or related areas with a strong understanding of secure coding practices and application security frameworks.

• Proficiency in programming languages (such as Python, Java, C++, etc.), knowledge of security tools (e.g., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP), and familiarity with security protocols and encryption methods.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex security issues to both technical and non-technical audiences

About OpenAI
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

Auth0, an Okta company, is the leading customer identity platform for developers. Our mission is to secure the world’s identities so innovators can innovate. As AI reshapes how applications are built and used, identity and security are becoming critical to enabling safe and trusted agentic experiences.

Our team builds Auth0 products for Agentic AI with a focus on agent identity, access management, and protocols that extend trust to our customers’ AI products. This includes enabling secure experiences for enterprise agents and the emerging class of personal agents that act on behalf of individuals.

The role is for a highly technical product manager who is adept at developing strong, customer-focused product strategies.

Responsibilities

• Define and Execute the AI Product Strategy: Drive the roadmap and execution for Auth0’s AI portfolio, with a specific focus on Auth0 for AI Agents. Identify tactical integration opportunities and ecosystem partnerships that secure agentic workflows and deliver immediate value to developers.

• Be an Owner and Builder (0-to-1): Bring a hands-on, entrepreneurial mindset to define, prototype, and launch new capabilities for AI applications. Balance rapid experimentation with the engineering discipline required to scale features into secure, production-grade products.

• Collaborate and Influence Without Authority: Serve as the core product owner and direct collaborator for engineering, design, and security teams. Translate the broader AI product vision into concrete, technical requirements, managing the backlog to ensure the timely delivery of developer-friendly features.

• Engage Directly with Developers and Customers: Gather direct feedback from the developer community and early adopters. Actively uncover pain points in AI implementation, including the needs of organizations building personal agents, and validate that Auth0’s AI capabilities solve real-world problems.

• Be an AI Standards Expert: Strategize and implement emerging standards in AI and identity, with a focus on Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent interoperability, and the protocols that enable trusted agentic experiences.

• Drive Cross-Functional Go-To-Market (GTM) Support: Partner closely with GTM teams (Product Marketing, Developer Relations, and Sales) to support successful product launches. Create technical enablement assets, documentation, and messaging to drive adoption of secure AI products.

Requirements

• Senior Product Management Experience: 5–7+ years of product management experience, with a proven track record of building world-class agentic products. Experience with B2C and B2B SaaS, as well as developer-facing products, is strongly preferred.

• Agentic AI Developer Credibility : Deep understanding of the emerging agent ecosystem, including personal agents. Ability to write code, work directly with APIs and SDKs, and build prototypes that validate customer and developer needs. Has defined and shipped successful API or SDK products for developer usage.

• Deep Technical Acumen and Hands-On Developer Credibility : Strong understanding of identity protocols such as OAuth, OIDC, and SAML, as well as AI protocols and technologies including MCP and mTLS.

• Proven “0-to-1” and Feature Launch Experience : Demonstrated success in building and launching new products, features, or programs from scratch, and executing the technical roadmap to scale them. Strong bias for execution and rapid prototyping. Startup founder or early-stage employee experience is a significant plus.

• Exceptional Product Instincts : Ability to deeply understand developer pain points, security requirements, and friction in AI experiences, translating them into compelling, secure, and integrated product experiences.

• Growth Mindset with Technical Depth : An individual contributor who is highly comfortable diving into technical API specifications, data schemas, and AI standards while collaborating on a Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy.

• Collaboration and Influence Without Authority : The ability to drive alignment and lead through influence in a highly cross-functional organization, working daily with engineering, design, product marketing, developer relations, and sales teams.

• Excellent Communication Skills : Consistently demonstrates an understanding of their audience when communicating by appropriately simplifying the message. The ability to concisely articulate complex technical architectures, developer workflows, and product value propositions clearly to both internal engineering teams and external developers.

• Passion for AI and Identity : A genuine enthusiasm for the potential of AI and a deep, demonstrable interest in the future of secure identity for users and agents.

About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role
The Credit Engineering team builds the systems that enable Ramp to manage credit lifecycles for businesses end-to-end, from initial underwriting through ongoing portfolio strategy optimization. As an engineer on Credit, you’ll own systems that influence $100+ billion in annual payment volume through millions of decisions across our product stack in support of the most ambitious FinTech portfolio in the United States.

We are looking for a backend engineer to own the technical roadmap for underwriting, limit management, portfolio optimization, and agentic workflows. You will build robust systems, automate complex operational tasks, and maintain the high-frequency controls that power all of Ramp’s products. If you are obsessed with correctness, excited by ambiguity, and passionate about problems at the intersection of distributed systems and financial strategy, this role is for you.

What You'll Do
• Architect scalable, stateful systems for automated limit management to optimize Ramp’s charge card portfolio.

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Ecosystem Operations Manager at GitLab, you'll own the technology, processes, and operational infrastructure behind our channel, distribution, original equipment manufacturer (OEM), global systems integrator (GSI), and managed service provider (MSP) partnerships. You'll shape how our partners go to market, serving as the primary process owner for deal registration, partner programs, partner quote-to-cash, and partner attribution. You'll combine operational strategy with hands-on execution, using artificial intelligence (AI) to automate workflows and help ecosystem operations scale.

What you'll do

• Design and govern end-to-end partner processes, including deal and referral registration, service attach, two-tier distribution, rules of engagement, and quote-to-cash. Partner with Deal Desk and Billing on resale, distribution, OEM, GSI, and MSP transaction workflows, and resolve complex registration, quoting, and billing escalations.

• Own operational execution of partner tiering, onboarding, certification compliance, not-for-resale (NFR) licenses, rebates, and incentives, including eligibility tracking, approval routing, and payments.

• Own and administer the partner technology ecosystem, including Impartner partner relationship management (PRM), Salesforce customer relationship management (CRM) partner objects, deal registration, and partner portals. Maintain system health and data integrity, and co-manage vendor roadmaps, renewals, and service-level accountability.

• Partner with Revenue Technologies and Systems to maintain integrations across partner platforms, Salesforce, enterprise resource planning (ERP), quoting, billing, and financial systems, including partner attribution and compensation data flows. Lead prioritization and user acceptance testing (UAT) for implementations, migrations, and platform enhancements with IT and Enterprise Applications.

• Own the ecosystem data model and work toward one standard partner attribution record across the customer lifecycle. Serve as a resource for Ecosystem Sales, partners, and internal teams on attribution, territory, and compensation-impacting data, and maintain reporting and dashboards as a single source of truth for partner pipeline, registration activity, and program performance.

• Lead ecosystem month-end close with Deal Desk, Compensation, Accounts Receivable, and Finance, covering opportunity corrections, partner splits, territory review, and reconciliation.

• Identify, build, and deploy AI agents to automate workflows such as deal registration routing, NFR provisioning, partner data quality checks, and reporting. Evaluate processes for opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and shorten cycle times.

• Maintain the authoritative ecosystem process map, runbooks, and training materials. Support tool configuration, testing, and end-user training. Own channel price files and partner quoting for product launches and stock keeping unit (SKU) changes. Coordinate improvements with operational peers, IT, Finance, Product, and Legal through GitLab Work Items.

What you'll bring

• Experience in business-to-business software-as-a-service channel or partner operations, with direct ownership of ecosystem workflows and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

• Hands-on experience with Impartner or an equivalent PRM platform, including deal registration and partner portal administration.

• Strong working knowledge of Salesforce CRM, including partner objects, opportunity management, Flow, validation rules, reports, and dashboards.

• Deep familiarity with resale, two-tier distribution, deal registration, rules of engagement, partner discounting, and partner quote-to-cash, plus an understanding of OEM, GSI, and MSP transaction structures and operational requirements.

• Direct experience operating partner programs, including tiering, certification compliance, rebates, and incentives, with responsibility for execution and compliance.

• Experience designing and documenting complex operational processes for distributed teams, translating business needs into detailed system requirements and configuration, and leading user acceptance testing through release.

• Hands-on experience using AI tools and building agents to automate operational workflows, from evaluating opportunities to delivering working solutions.

• Experience resolving ambiguous operational escalations across systems, teams, and partner relationships, and aligning Deal Desk, IT, Finance, Compensation, Legal, and Sales around operational changes.

About the team

Our Ecosystem Operations team works closely with Systems, Revenue Technologies, Deal Desk, Ecosystem Programs, Enablement, Finance, Compensation, and Legal. We enable consistent execution across Ecosystem Operations Specialists and cross-functional partners. You'll also partner with the Senior Hyperscaler Operations Manager, who owns Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud operations, on shared systems, the ecosystem data model, and month-end close.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity . Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

$104,800 — $176,400 USD

jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers, sharp problem-solvers, and builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency – it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Advisory Products team is redefining the advisor experience by bringing the best of Robinhood’s technology, design, and infrastructure to Registered Investment Advisors (RIAs) and the clients they serve. Following our TradePMR acquisition, we’re building a modern advisor platform – custody, tools, and a two-sided marketplace that connects Robinhood’s investors with trusted, growth-oriented advisors.

As the Product Manager for the Advisor Marketplace, you will own the product that helps investors find, meet, and fund accounts with the right advisor – and helps advisors win and onboard those clients efficiently. You’ll own the full marketplace funnel, from demand generation and matching through first meeting, onboarding, and funded account, and you’ll use data and experimentation to make every step work better for both sides. This is an opportunity to take a new, high-visibility business from early traction to scale, in close partnership with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, Operations, and Compliance.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

• Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Advisor Marketplace, balancing the needs of both sides – investors looking for advice and advisors looking to grow their practices.

• Own the end-to-end marketplace funnel – discovery, matching and routing, scheduling, first-meeting show rate, advisor onboarding, and funded accounts – and drive measurable improvements at each stage.

• Define and manage marketplace health: supply and demand balance, advisor quality and standards, lead allocation, and conversion, with clear metrics such as meetings booked and completed, accounts funded, assets under management, and net flows.

• Partner with Engineering, Design, and Data Science to ship products from concept to production, using research, experimentation, and analytics to guide prioritization and measure success.

• Work with Compliance, Legal, and Risk to embed regulatory and operational requirements directly into product design, advisor vetting, disclosures, and workflows.

• Integrate the marketplace with the broader RIA platform, including TradePMR and Robinhood’s app, so that advisor and client data, accounts, and custody flows connect seamlessly.

• Drive go-to-market execution with Marketing, Sales, and Operations across launches, advisor acquisition and onboarding, support readiness, and cross-functional communication.

• Explore how AI can improve the client experience when working with an advisor.

• Stay ahead of trends in wealth management, advisor technology, and marketplaces to inform long-term strategy.

What you bring

• 4+ years of product management experience, including building and launching marketplace, platform, or complex multi-sided products, ideally in fintech, brokerage, or wealth management.

• Demonstrated success owning a funnel or growth-oriented product end-to-end, with a track record of improving conversion and engagement through experimentation and analytics.

• Experience delivering products in a regulated or compliance-heavy environment, balancing innovation with operational and regulatory rigor.

• Strong analytical skills: you define success metrics, write your own queries or dashboards, and use data to drive prioritization and continuous improvement.

• Strong technical acumen and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, and operations teams on system design, integrations, and scalability.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to align diverse stakeholders – including executives, advisors, and partner teams – around a shared roadmap.

• An ownership mindset and a scrappy, self-starter attitude: comfortable with ambiguity, able to define what “great” looks like as you go.

• Passion for empowering financial advisors and their clients, and for transforming the wealth management industry through modern technology.

Bonus points

• Experience building two-sided marketplaces, lead-generation or referral products, or CRM and scheduling workflows.

• Experience shipping AI-enabled features in B2B or consumer products.

What we offer

• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career

• Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching

• Best-in-class benefits, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents

• Lifestyle wallet – a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more

• Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits

• Time off to recharge, including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more

• Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

Base Pay Range:

Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC)
$166,000 — $195,000 USD

Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL)
$146,000 — $172,000 USD

Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL)
$129,000 — $152,000 USD

Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

jobs.description:
As a Research Engineer on our team, you will partner with Research Scientists, working on fundamental research problems and collaborating with Datadog’s Product and Engineering teams to help translate research advances into tangible benefits for our customers.

Building on our proven track record of delivering AI-powered solutions, including Bits AI , Toto 2.0 , and Scout , Datadog AI Research ( DAIR ) pursues ambitious, high-risk, high-reward research initiatives focused on solving real-world challenges in cloud observability and security.

We are currently focused on two key research areas:

•
Observability Foundation Models – Building state-of-the-art models for advanced forecasting, anomaly detection, and multi-modal telemetry analysis (logs, metrics, traces, etc.). These models will also provide the foundation for our decision models to natively analyze telemetry data.

•
Observability Native Decision Models – Developing multimodal (logs, traces, metrics, text, images, ...) hybrid decision and reasoning models that are general and efficient enough to be watching your entire system continuously and effectively. Building and training hybrid Decision/Generative systems, e.g., decision models call on agentic models for deeper investigations or support evidence.

What You'll Do:

•
Build and operate multimodal data pipelines, training and evaluation infrastructure, benchmarks, and internal tooling

•
Implement models, run experiments at scale, and profile for reliability, performance, and cost

•
Build simulation environments and replay infrastructure for agent training and evaluation

•
Orchestrate distributed training and distributed RL with Ray, including scheduling, scaling, and failure recovery

•
Establish rigorous automated benchmarks and regression tests for world model predictions, agent performance, and simulation fidelity

•
Collaborate with Research Scientists, Product, and Engineering to integrate capabilities into Datadog's products and to harden prototypes into reliable services

•
Share research findings with external audiences upon reaching significant project milestones.

Who You Are:

•
You have depth in distributed computing, RL Infra, and ML systems for training and inference at scale; experience with Ray, Slurm, or similar frameworks is a plus

•
You are proficient in Python, familiar with a systems language (e.g., Rust, C++, or Go), and comfortable with modern cloud and data infrastructure

•
You have practical experience implementing and operating ML training and inference systems (e.g., PyTorch or JAX ), including containerization, orchestration, and GPU acceleration

•
You have practical experience with large-scale model training and fine-tuning, including frameworks like Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, SkyRL, VeRL, or TorchTitan, and techniques such as SFT , RLVR , RLHF , and efficient inference (quantization, speculative decoding)

•
You can explain design and performance trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

•
You have experience supporting or contributing to research publications

Bonus Points (any of the following):

•
You have strong software engineering skills with experience in domains such as observability, SRE, or security

•
You have experience bridging research prototypes and real-world product applications, especially with large foundation models, world models, or RL-trained agents

•
You have a passion for pushing the boundaries of AI with a focus on customer impact and scalable deployment

•
You have hands-on experience with GPU programming and optimization, including CUDA

•
You have experience writing production data pipelines and applications

•
You have experience building simulation or sandbox environments for agent training

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence.
